description: Read or set the device's network conditions. Offline blocks new intercepted HTTP requests; slow adds 500 ms and verySlow adds 2000 ms before dispatch. Normal clears conditions. State resets on JS reload. Check app and server observations to verify the effect.

action.description: Read the effective profile or select one.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

name: network_conditions
